VulkanMod Reforged for Minecraft 1.21.11 (NeoForge).

Experimental port. Compatibility and feature parity are incomplete.

Install only the production JAR in the matching loader/version. The source JAR and source ZIP are for development. SHA256SUMS.txt lists download checksums.

The source ZIP contains the corresponding source and build scripts for this commit. LGPL-3.0-only; preserve applicable notices and identify modified versions. See LICENSE, COPYING, and NOTICE.
